headline: 1947: a gallon of paint cost *$2.98*
quote: That's how much money it will take to buy a gallon of paint
title: Prices in 1947: a gallon of paint cost $2.98
caption: From "What Is Money?" (1947): Tom gets a crisp new $5 bill to buy a $2.98 gallon of paint.
comment: What does a gallon of paint cost where you live? 👇
